# Security policy

Please don't report security vulnerabilities in public issues.

Report them privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/texfolia/texfolia/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected app or package, steps to reproduce, and the impact you
expect. We aim to acknowledge reports within three business days and will keep
you informed until a fix ships.

## Supported versions

Texfolia is pre-release. Only the latest commit on `main` and the deployed
service at [texfolia.com](https://www.texfolia.com) receive security fixes.

## Scope

In scope: the product app, the marketing and docs sites, the compiler and its
LaTeX engine, and the code in this repository. Out of scope: denial of service
through volume alone, findings that need a compromised device or account, and
issues in third-party services that Texfolia uses.
